name: Milkshake
description: Milk blended with ice cream and flavouring until it barely moves through a straw.

tcm.note: Iced dairy is cold and damp-forming — read with ice cream.

ayurveda.note: Shita and very guru; classically the wrong thing on a weak digestion.

histamine.note: The base is modest; chocolate and strawberry versions inherit those triggers.
